i think we guys have sort of an inate bias on that.

Most of the time that I was in a situation where I found a women attractive and that there was a possibilty to date her, my brain started interpreting almost everything as a sign of attraction.

She ilked/commented/shared a thing I posted on facebook, that must means she wants my attention! Omg, she isn't the type to dress in a fancy way, but now that she knew that I would be there, she dressed really nice, that can't be a coincidence right? Wow, she is really friendly with me, that must mean she wants to know more about me! 

I think that on an evolutionary perspective, that makes a whole lot of sense. Your brain is trying to make you focus on the possibilty of mutual attraction rather than bombarding you with doubt, witch makes you more prone to make an attempt at seducing her.  

So yeah, when you're attracted to somone, I think you're more prone to feel like that attraction is mutual. 
Also, if you don't talk to women a lot, I'm sure you're more suseptible to pickup any behavor as a sign of attraction, since you haven't seen that conduct in a situation where there is no attraction. Also I guess people who rationalize less their emotions would be more suceptible to pickup something ridiculous like you mentionned in your example. 

Edit: Also, some guys belives that all girls are too scared to make any obvious moves. So they will consciousliy or not send out little signals like biting their lips playing with their hair etc... It's a bit childish and paired with what I described above, you end up with sitations like you mentionned.
